title: Analysis of Creative Arts and Sports
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Creative Arts and Sports; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Arts and Sports teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Analyse a folk song and a story the class performed; model evidence-based comments.

skills.key_step: The child names the values of clean sport (fair play, honesty, respect, teamwork, discipline) and says cheating and drugs spoil sport.

floor.question: What should a batter do with the bat after hitting?

steps: Name the value kept or broken.
contexts: a football match where a player owns up to a handball

board.do: A player helps an injured opponent.

misconceptions.repair: Ask: does this make the game fairer or less fair?

misconceptions.ask: Which is a value of clean sport?
misconceptions.repair: List what happens to a game when everyone cheats.

misconceptions.ask: What matters in a team game?
misconceptions.repair: Discuss a team that lost but played fairly and well together.

misconceptions.ask: Is using drugs to win allowed if nobody sees?
misconceptions.repair: Talk about athletes banned for doping.

checks.question: Name a value of clean sport.
checks.answer: any of: fair play, honesty, respect, teamwork, discipline

skills.key_step: The child analyses a folk song (community, occasion, type, message, soloist and chorus, instruments, costume) and a story performance (theme, characters, techniques, lesson) with evidence.

floor.prerequisite: Names the elements and message of a song (Grade 6).
floor.question: Where do you find a song's message?

steps: Note what you hear and see.

board.do: The chorus repeats the soloist's line.

misconceptions.ask: Which is an analysis of a folk song?
misconceptions.repair: Ask "what did you hear or see that shows that?" after each point.

listen_for: the hare tricked the hyena and ran away
misconceptions.ask: What is the theme of the story we watched?
misconceptions.repair: Ask "what is the story teaching?" after retelling.

listen_for: a dance song, because it is fast
misconceptions.ask: A fast song is sung while winnowing. What type is it?
misconceptions.repair: Look at the occasion and the words first.

misconceptions.ask: Name a technique the storyteller used.
misconceptions.repair: Ask "how did she tell it?" not "what was it about?".

checks.question: Name two things to say when analysing a folk song.
checks.answer: any two of: community, occasion, type, message, soloist and chorus, instruments, costume

checks.question: What is the theme of a story?
checks.answer: the idea or lesson it teaches
